unit.why: A single narrative: at a wedding in Kalev, R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov arrives in Hungary, the hasidim leave the other tzaddikim to greet him, and he placates them, which leads to a match between the families.
unit.boundary_note: next division (לה) continues the motif of the sign on the governor's forehead

stories.start_quote: בעת עשה הרב האלקי מו"ה יצחק אייזיק
stories.summary_en: At a wedding hosted by R. Yitzhak Isaac of Kalev in Hungary, the hasidim abandon the assembled tzaddikim to greet the arriving R. Zvi Hirsh; he senses their offense, forces his way into their lodging, apologizes and explains that he knows the governor of the land (by a scar on his forehead), and they forgive him; a match between the two families follows.

quotes: עשה הרב האלקי מו"ה יצחק אייזיק טוב מקאהלוב במדינת הגר נישואין
כי הקדושים הנ"ל רוצים לנגוע בו לרעה
